description: This Java class provides utility methods for symmetric encryption and decryption using a specified cipher type. It includes methods to encrypt data to a Base64 string and decrypt data from a Base64 string, employing PBKDF2 key derivation with salt and IV (Initialization Vector) for secure encryption.

classes.name: EncryptionUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for encrypting and decrypting data using symmetric key encryption with salt and IV protection.

methods.name: encryptToBase64
methods.description: Encrypts a given string using a specified cipher type and master password, returning the result as a Base64 encoded string.

methods.name: decryptFromBase64
methods.description: Decrypts a Base64 encoded encrypted string back to the original plaintext using the specified cipher type and master password.

methods.name: generateKeySpec
methods.description: Generates a SecretKeySpec object from the master password and salt using PBKDF2 with HMACSHA1, configured for AES-256.
